paraphrase: No arena has a reason-closed account of a contingent explanandum whose contingent reason relation is well-founded and whose reasons for contingent members are all contingent; replacing that last condition with all reasons necessitating, or with truth-discriminating contrast relevance, also gives inconsistency. For the first bundle, one named model each keeps the other members and refutes the deleted one: a brute contingent terminus has no reason-closed account, a source-free infinite chain is not well-founded, a necessary reason for a contingent target is not contingent, and a target with no rival is not contingent. The core forces rejection of at least one member and chooses none.
